field_updates.detail: "Forward Current vs. Forward Voltage", High Efficiency Red, "Ta = 25 °C" (linear 0-50 mA vs 1.5-2.5 V). Read points: 0.81 mA @ 1.625 V (resid +0.9 mV); 1.08 mA @ 1.650 V (resid +1.0 mV); 1.34 mA @ 1.670 V (resid +1.4 mV); 1.61 mA @ 1.685 V (resid -0.0 mV); 1.88 mA @ 1.700 V (resid +0.8 mV); 2.42 mA @ 1.718 V (resid -4.1 mV); 3.23 mA @ 1.743 V (resid -7.5 mV); 5.11 mA @ 1.798 V (resid -1.8 mV); 7.53 mA @ 1.848 V (resid +1.1 mV); 8.60 mA @ 1.873 V (resid +8.4 mV); 9.95 mA @ 1.893 V (resid +7.9 mV); 11.22 mA @ 1.908 V (resid +4.8 mV); 12.30 mA @ 1.923 V (resid +5.4 mV); 14.99 mA @ 1.948 V (resid -3.2 mV); 16.33 mA @ 1.963 V (resid -3.9 mV); 17.67 mA @ 1.978 V (resid -4.1 mV); 19.02 mA @ 1.993 V (resid -3.8 mV); 20.09 mA @ 2.003 V (resid -5.3 mV); 20.63 mA @ 2.012 V (resid -2.2 mV); 21.17 mA @ 2.017 V (resid -2.8 mV); 21.98 mA @ 2.027 V (resid -1.1 mV); 24.06 mA @ 2.047 V (resid -2.0 mV); 25.94 mA @ 2.067 V (resid -0.4 mV); 28.09 mA @ 2.092 V (resid +4.0 mV); 29.97 mA @ 2.112 V (resid +6.5 mV). Cross-check: model VF(20 mA)=2.007 V vs stated typ 2.00 V (+7 mV); "Forward Voltage IF = 20mA VF High Efficiency Red 2 2.5 V" (p2). Method: Curve read from the PDF vector polyline vertices (pdftocairo -svg), axes calibrated from gridlines; vertices with I >= 0.8 mA used (current quantised at ~0.27 mA by the drawing, so sub-mA vertices dropped). Least-squares fit of V = N*Vt*ln(I/IS) + I*RS (linear in N*Vt, N*Vt*ln IS, RS), Vt = kT/q at 25 C = 0.02569 V. Fit 25 points 0.81-30.0 mA, rms 4.1 mV. Window sensitivity: lower bound 0.8/1.3/2/5 mA gives N 2.71-3.31, RS 6.2-7.2 ohm. IS, N and RS are strongly correlated and must be used together as one set; individually they are not identified by this curve. If used in a .model with TNOM=27 C, re-reference IS or set TNOM=25.
